design.decision: Every side-suit winner becomes a sure trick, so bid off honors and long side suits, lead them late, and stop fearing voids.
design.opponent: Revealed the first time a trump fails to beat your card; opponents must win in-suit or strip your cards by leading [♠]s.
design.rationale: A memorable rule change that rewrites how the owner plays every hand and helps any build that wins tricks; it is the broad version of ua-aces-untrumpable and ua-diamonds-untrumpable, placed at legendary for its power.
design.draftText: Your team's cards other than [♠] can't be trumped

critic.concerns: Functionally identical to ra-team-untrumpable: the kernel only shields cards that follow a non-[♠] led suit, so the 'other than [♠]' filter changes nothing and only adds a condition.
